scope: Static review of one bounded SEC companyfacts source-qualification plan, its small parser, notebook/workflow identity, prior source Recorder manifest/summary metadata, and the reported synthetic check. Reviewer did not load actual companyfacts payloads, annual financial values, native calendar rows, market prices, labels, model fits, accounts, or any Recorder object.
notebook_identity_rule: SHA256 of sorted compact JSON notebook after clearing code-cell outputs and execution counts; code and markdown source remain in the identity.
verified_contracts: The four prior Recorder artifact identities and source summary/manifest and Qlib day-calendar SHA match the frozen plan metadata. The run requires a separate exact root GO for the frozen plan, parser and normalized notebook before any real payload or calendar read.

The allowed annual fields are fixed: InventoryNet or IFRS Inventories, predefined US-GAAP revenue tags or IFRS Revenue, and Assets only as a diagnostic. Revenue must cover 330-380 days on 10-K/20-F/40-F; inventory is an instant at the same fiscal end, same issuer, taxonomy, currency and accession. No quarter or TTM values are fabricated.

The parser selects the earliest eligible non-amended Companyfacts row in this admitted corpus, excludes conflicting earliest aliases/values/accessions, and requires contiguous prior/current annual revenue periods with stable tag, form, taxonomy and currency. It does not certify original filing text or historical first publication.

Each issuer-month support row records the disclosed security identity, original weight, mapping identity_status, selected unique latest conditionally available annual-pair accession and fiscal end, or an explicit ambiguity/missing/staleness reason. Monthly covered weight sums original disclosed security weights without renormalizing uncovered names.

The conditional availability proxy is the first native session strictly after the date-only filed field. Strict historical original-document, first-receipt, issuer-identity and PIT-qualified coverage remain zero. Mechanical source feasibility and conditional coverage are reported separately from model-input qualification.

The source-only run uses one Qlib D.calendar call, a native DatasetH qualification panel and one new Recorder/NAS archive. It makes no D.features price query, external HTTP request, factor value, return label, fit or account. The result decision distinguishes actual mechanical annual-pair support from zero-pair needs_data.
focused_synthetic_evidence: Executor reported one synthetic check passed against the final module identity, covering earliest-versus-later and amended filings, earliest conflicts, same-accession annual pairs, latest unique pair or ambiguity, unreweighted conditional coverage, issuer-month identity ledger and native DatasetH prepare readback. Reviewer did not rerun it or read real source values.
approval_boundary: Approval permits only this single bounded source-feasibility attempt. A positive mechanical annual-pair count may support a later separately frozen diagnostic after specific issuer identity and timing work; it does not establish original-document semantics, certified historical PIT, factor effectiveness, fee-net SOXX excess or promotion. A zero-pair result is needs_data for these fixed tags and periods, not a block on unrelated research.
